title: Novvin message shared content
description: Supply sharedContent on a native message POST with a stable UUID and optional note in content. The server uses content_type shared_content. History, delivery and receipts carry the message ID and note, not the source reference or preview. Resolve on GET /v1/data/messages/{chats|groups|communities}/{scopeId}/messages/{messageId}/shared-content. Inaccessible or missing messages and sources return 404 without preview; responses are not cacheable.

messageFields.description: Same content and sharedContent are required for a replay using the same message ID. The destination and channel use the existing message route fields.
